Tønder is a Danish town and municipality situated in the Region of Southern Denmark (Region Syddanmark). Within the context of the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, Tønder is documented as a specific geographic unit for evaluating clinical quality and patient outcomes related to atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1], [^src2]. 

The municipality is explicitly tracked in the report's detailed breakdowns of clinical indicators. For Indicator 5, which measures the occurrence of ischemic stroke (iskæmisk apopleksi) as a complication, the data shows that 4 out of 1,072 patients in Tønder were registered with the condition, resulting in a rate of 0.4% [^src1]. Furthermore, Tønder is included in the tabular data on page 94, which outlines additional municipality-level metrics, showing a 0.3% rate for one measured outcome and a 0.6% rate (6 out of 1,065 patients) for another [^src2]. These statistics are part of the comprehensive regional and municipal benchmarking conducted by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to guide local quality development and assess the effectiveness of anticoagulation strategies across all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1], [^src2].
